name: Ruta Vetra
source:
The organizer of cultural life in Pogranichnoye.

Artistic, ambitious, and domineering. Ruta lives for art, turning theater into a means of influencing people and changing their perception of the world. However, behind her desire to control the feelings of others lies her own fear of powerlessness and irreversible mistakes.
